options.says: The caller keeps the omitted piece numbers and gap durations with the completed joined file and supplies them at the next launch.

model.name: recording piece custody

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The recording starts in Init and follows the modeled bookkeeping and caller steps.

statements.name: ClosedPiecesProtected
statements.says: Every closed piece remains unchanged and present until hand-over is confirmed and the three-day retention period has passed.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every saved value, caller observation and history value has its declared type.

statements.name: NamesRequireDurableBytes
statements.says: A piece receives its name only after the caller has flushed all of its bytes.

statements.name: NoClosedNumberReuse
statements.says: A new piece never takes the number of a piece that has already closed.

statements.name: WholePiecesAreNamed
statements.says: Only named pieces are recorded as whole, except while their authorized removal is being acknowledged.

statements.name: ClosedPiecesAreSequential
statements.says: Closed pieces are numbered consecutively from one.

statements.name: RecoveryAndContinuationUseDisk
statements.says: Before capture starts or resumes, the saved list matches the named pieces on disk and the next number follows the last of them.

statements.name: CrashPreservesClosedPieces
statements.says: A crash cannot lose any closed piece before the recording becomes eligible for removal.

statements.name: OpenDebrisIsNotWhole
statements.says: An unfinished piece under a hidden name is never a named whole piece.

statements.name: JoinHasNoOpenPiece
statements.says: Joining starts only after capture has ended for good and no open piece or hidden piece remains.

statements.name: JoinUsesEveryClosedPieceInOrder
statements.says: Every join request contains every closed piece exactly once in number order and nothing else.

statements.name: JoinedFileContainsTheReadableRemainder
statements.says: A completed joined file contains all readable pieces in order and cannot omit every piece.

statements.name: JoinedFileIsNamedOnce
statements.says: The recording produces at most one named joined file, including across crashes.

statements.name: GapDetailsSurvive
statements.says: Every named joined file has durable companion information identifying the omitted pieces, whose saved durations determine its gaps.

statements.name: GapsAreReported
statements.says: Once the completed joined file is recognized, the outcome reports each omitted piece and its full duration as a gap.

statements.name: UnreadablePiecesAreRetained
statements.says: Pieces omitted as unreadable remain with the recording until confirmed hand-over and the retention period permit removal.

statements.name: OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver
statements.says: The only file this recording can hand over is its single complete joined file, never a piece.

statements.name: HandedOverMeansConfirmed
statements.says: The recording counts as handed over exactly when the hand-over component confirms its joined file.

statements.name: FailedWorkKeepsRecordingAndError
statements.says: A reported join or hand-over failure keeps every closed piece and exposes the error and spool location in the outcome.

statements.name: FailedJoinHandsOverNothing
statements.says: A reported failed join has no completed output to hand over and has handed over nothing.

statements.name: FailedWriteStopsCapture
statements.says: After a piece-write failure is recorded, that capture cannot accept another piece.

statements.name: EmptyRecordingHasNoOutput
statements.says: A recording with no closed piece reports nothing recorded and produces no joined or handed-over file.

statements.name: RemovalRequiresHandoverAndTime
statements.says: Piece removal can be requested or completed only after confirmed hand-over and the caller reports that three days have passed.

statements.name: NormalHandover
statements.says: A recording with no unreadable piece can be handed over.

statements.name: HandoverWithGap
statements.says: A recording with an unreadable piece can hand over the readable remainder with a reported gap.

statements.name: JoinFailureIsKept
statements.says: A join can fail and leave the recording kept with its error.

statements.name: UnreadableRecordingIsKept
statements.says: A join that cannot read any piece can fail while keeping the recording.

statements.name: RepeatedInterruptionIsReported
statements.says: Repeated interrupted joins can reach the configured limit and report a failure.

statements.name: HandoverFailureIsKept
statements.says: Hand-over can fail while the recording remains kept.

statements.name: WriteFailureIsReported
statements.says: A failed piece write can report that capture cannot continue.

statements.name: NothingRecorded
statements.says: Finishing without a closed piece can report that nothing was recorded.

statements.name: PiecesEventuallyRemoved
statements.says: The pieces of a handed-over recording can be removed after retention expires.

statements.name: NamedPieceBeforeRecord
statements.says: A crash can occur after a piece receives its name but before the saved record includes it.

statements.name: NamedJoinBeforeRecord
statements.says: A crash can occur after the joined file receives its name but before the saved phase records completion.

statements.name: RecordingCanContinue
statements.says: After recovery, capture can continue with piece two following closed piece one.

statements.name: RetryCanBePending
statements.says: A failed join can have a retry pending while the app is running.

statements.name: RetryIsScheduled
statements.says: A pending retry is eventually requested unless another crash interrupts the running app.

statements.name: FinishRequestsJoin
statements.says: Finishing a recording with closed pieces eventually requests its join unless another crash interrupts the running app.

statements.name: EmptyFinishReportsNothing
statements.says: Finishing an empty recording eventually reports nothing recorded unless another crash interrupts the running app.

statements.name: HandoverIsRequested
statements.says: A recognized joined file eventually gets a hand-over request unless another crash interrupts the running app.

statements.name: RemovalIsRequested
statements.says: After the retention period is reported, piece removal is eventually requested unless another crash interrupts the running app.

statements.name: RetrySchedulingIsFair
statements.says: A continuously enabled internal retry-scheduling step eventually runs.

statements.name: FinishSchedulingIsFair
statements.says: A continuously enabled internal join-request step eventually runs.

statements.name: EmptyReportingIsFair
statements.says: A continuously enabled internal empty-recording report eventually runs.

statements.name: HandoverSchedulingIsFair
statements.says: A continuously enabled internal hand-over-request step eventually runs.

statements.name: RemovalSchedulingIsFair
statements.says: A continuously enabled internal piece-removal request eventually runs.

statements.name: RemoveBeforeHandover
statements.says: A possible faulty implementation deletes closed pieces before hand-over is confirmed.

statements.name: ReuseNumberFromStaleRecord
statements.says: A possible faulty recovery reuses a closed piece number from the stale saved count.

statements.name: NameUnflushedPiece
statements.says: A possible faulty implementation names a piece whose write did not flush its bytes.

statements.name: ForgetGapDetails
statements.says: A possible faulty implementation loses the gap information for an already named joined file.

model.module_text:
---- MODULE PieceCustody ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, MaxInterruptions, Durations, SpoolPath
VARIABLES phase, rec, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered,
          prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications

vars == <<phase, rec, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered,
          prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces

JoinedFile == 0

Phases == {"capture", "paused", "write", "name", "discard", "finish",
           "join", "publish", "joinFailed", "ready", "deliver",
           "deliveryFailed", "handed", "remove", "done", "empty"}

Errors == {"", "write", "joinError", "allUnreadable", "interrupted", "handover"}

Replies == {"none", "writeOK", "writeError", "named", "discarded",
            "joining", "joinOK", "joinError", "allUnreadable", "prepared", "removed"}

Ordered(ps) ==
    [i \in 1..Cardinality(ps) |->
        CHOOSE p \in ps : Cardinality({q \in ps : q <= p}) = i]

EligibleForRemoval == rec.handed /\ rec.elapsed

NextPiece == Cardinality(rec.closed) + 1

GapDetails(ps) == {[piece |-> p, seconds |-> lengths[p]] : p \in ps}

Outcome ==
    [status |-> IF phase = "empty" THEN "nothingRecorded"
                ELSE IF rec.handed THEN "handedOver"
                ELSE IF phase = "joinFailed" THEN "joinFailed"
                ELSE IF phase = "deliveryFailed" THEN "handoverFailed"
                ELSE IF rec.writeFailed /\ ~rec.finishing THEN "cannotContinue"
                ELSE "pending",
     error |-> rec.error,
     spool |-> SpoolPath,
     gaps |-> GapDetails(rec.omissions)]

TypeOK ==
    /\ MaxPieces \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ MaxInterruptions \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ Durations \subseteq Nat \ {0}
    /\ Durations # {}
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ rec \in [closed : SUBSET Pieces, open : 0..MaxPieces,
                 finishing : BOOLEAN, capturing : BOOLEAN, writeFailed : BOOLEAN,
                 omissions : SUBSET Pieces,
                 input : UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces},
                 interruptions : 0..MaxInterruptions, error : Errors,
                 handed : BOOLEAN, elapsed : BOOLEAN, retry : BOOLEAN]
    /\ disk \in [named : SUBSET Pieces, hidden : 0..MaxPieces,
                  flushed : BOOLEAN, partial : BOOLEAN, joined : BOOLEAN,
                  omitted : SUBSET Pieces, manifest : SUBSET Pieces,
                  fileOrder : UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}]
    /\ live \in BOOLEAN
    /\ reply \in Replies
    /\ lengths \in [Pieces -> Durations]
    /\ everClosed \subseteq Pieces
    /\ altered \subseteq Pieces
    /\ prematureName \in BOOLEAN
    /\ delivered \subseteq Pieces \cup {JoinedFile}
    /\ recovered \in BOOLEAN
    /\ joinPublications \in 0..2

ClosedPiecesProtected ==
    /\ altered = {}
    /\ ~EligibleForRemoval => disk.named = everClosed

NamesRequireDurableBytes == ~prematureName

NoClosedNumberReuse ==
    (live /\ phase = "write") => rec.open \notin everClosed

WholePiecesAreNamed ==
    /\ disk.named \subseteq everClosed
    /\ phase \notin {"remove", "done"} => rec.closed \subseteq disk.named

ClosedPiecesAreSequential == everClosed = 1..Cardinality(everClosed)

RecoveryAndContinuationUseDisk ==
    (live /\ phase \in {"capture", "paused"}) =>
        /\ rec.closed = disk.named
        /\ NextPiece = Cardinality(disk.named) + 1

CrashPreservesClosedPieces ==
    (~live /\ ~EligibleForRemoval) => everClosed \subseteq disk.named

OpenDebrisIsNotWhole ==
    disk.hidden # 0 => disk.hidden \notin disk.named

JoinHasNoOpenPiece ==
    phase \in {"join", "publish", "ready", "deliver", "deliveryFailed",
               "handed", "remove", "done"} =>
        /\ rec.open = 0
        /\ disk.hidden = 0
        /\ rec.finishing

JoinUsesEveryClosedPieceInOrder ==
    phase \in {"join", "publish", "ready", "deliver", "deliveryFailed",
               "handed", "remove", "done"} =>
        /\ rec.input = Ordered(everClosed)
        /\ Len(rec.input) > 0

JoinedFileContainsTheReadableRemainder ==
    disk.joined =>
        /\ disk.omitted \subseteq everClosed
        /\ disk.omitted # everClosed
        /\ disk.fileOrder = Ordered(everClosed \ disk.omitted)

JoinedFileIsNamedOnce ==
    /\ joinPublications <= 1
    /\ disk.joined = (joinPublications = 1)

GapDetailsSurvive == disk.joined => disk.manifest = disk.omitted

GapsAreReported ==
    (live /\ phase \in {"ready", "deliver", "deliveryFailed", "handed", "remove", "done"}) =>
        /\ rec.omissions = disk.omitted
        /\ Outcome.gaps = GapDetails(disk.omitted)

UnreadablePiecesAreRetained ==
    (disk.joined /\ ~EligibleForRemoval) => disk.omitted \subseteq disk.named

OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver ==
    /\ delivered \subseteq {JoinedFile}
    /\ Cardinality(delivered) <= 1
    /\ delivered # {} => disk.joined

HandedOverMeansConfirmed == rec.handed = (JoinedFile \in delivered)

FailedWorkKeepsRecordingAndError ==
    phase \in {"joinFailed", "deliveryFailed"} =>
        /\ ~rec.handed
        /\ disk.named = everClosed
        /\ Outcome.error # ""
        /\ Outcome.spool = SpoolPath

FailedJoinHandsOverNothing ==
    phase = "joinFailed" => ~disk.joined /\ delivered = {}

FailedWriteStopsCapture == rec.writeFailed => ~rec.capturing

EmptyRecordingHasNoOutput ==
    phase = "empty" =>
        /\ everClosed = {}
        /\ ~disk.joined
        /\ delivered = {}
        /\ Outcome.status = "nothingRecorded"

RemovalRequiresHandoverAndTime == phase \in {"remove", "done"} => EligibleForRemoval

RetryIsScheduled ==
    (live /\ rec.retry) ~> (~live \/ phase = "join")

FinishRequestsJoin ==
    (live /\ phase = "finish" /\ rec.closed # {}) ~> (~live \/ phase = "join")

EmptyFinishReportsNothing ==
    (live /\ phase = "finish" /\ rec.closed = {}) ~> (~live \/ phase = "empty")

HandoverIsRequested ==
    (live /\ phase = "ready") ~> (~live \/ phase = "deliver" \/ rec.handed)

RemovalIsRequested ==
    (live /\ phase = "handed" /\ rec.elapsed) ~> (~live \/ phase = "remove" \/ phase = "done")

NormalHandover == rec.handed /\ rec.omissions = {} /\ everClosed # {}

HandoverWithGap == rec.handed /\ rec.omissions # {}

JoinFailureIsKept == phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.error = "joinError"

UnreadableRecordingIsKept == phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.error = "allUnreadable"

RepeatedInterruptionIsReported == phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.error = "interrupted"

HandoverFailureIsKept == phase = "deliveryFailed"

WriteFailureIsReported == rec.writeFailed /\ ~rec.finishing /\ Outcome.status = "cannotContinue"

NothingRecorded == phase = "empty"

PiecesEventuallyRemoved == phase = "done" /\ everClosed # {} /\ disk.named = {}

NamedPieceBeforeRecord == ~live /\ disk.named \ rec.closed # {}

NamedJoinBeforeRecord == ~live /\ disk.joined /\ phase \in {"join", "publish"}

RecordingCanContinue == recovered /\ phase = "write" /\ rec.open = 2 /\ rec.closed = {1}

RetryCanBePending == live /\ phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.retry

Init ==
    /\ phase = "capture"
    /\ rec = [closed |-> {}, open |-> 0, finishing |-> FALSE,
               capturing |-> TRUE, writeFailed |-> FALSE, omissions |-> {},
               input |-> <<>>, interruptions |-> 0, error |-> "",
               handed |-> FALSE, elapsed |-> FALSE, retry |-> FALSE]
    /\ disk = [named |-> {}, hidden |-> 0, flushed |-> FALSE,
                partial |-> FALSE, joined |-> FALSE, omitted |-> {},
                manifest |-> {}, fileOrder |-> <<>>]
    /\ live = TRUE
    /\ reply = "none"
    /\ lengths \in [Pieces -> Durations]
    /\ everClosed = {}
    /\ altered = {}
    /\ prematureName = FALSE
    /\ delivered = {}
    /\ recovered = FALSE
    /\ joinPublications = 0

\* rec and phase are the caller's atomically saved record. A change asking
\* for I/O precedes its caller effect. disk models observations, not I/O by
\* this package. lengths are caller-supplied, fixed positive piece durations.
BeginPiece ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "capture" /\ rec.capturing
    /\ ~rec.finishing /\ ~rec.writeFailed
    /\ NextPiece <= MaxPieces /\ disk.hidden = 0 /\ rec.open = 0
    /\ phase' = "write"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.open = NextPiece]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

WritePiece ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "write" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = rec.open, !.flushed = TRUE]
    /\ reply' = "writeOK"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

FailPieceWrite ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "write" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = rec.open, !.flushed = FALSE]
    /\ reply' = "writeError"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RequestPieceName ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "write" /\ reply = "writeOK"
    /\ phase' = "name" /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

NamePiece ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "name" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ disk.flushed /\ disk.hidden = rec.open /\ rec.open \notin disk.named
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.named = @ \cup {rec.open}, !.hidden = 0, !.flushed = FALSE]
    /\ everClosed' = everClosed \cup {rec.open}
    /\ reply' = "named"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RecordPieceName ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "name" /\ reply = "named"
    /\ phase' = IF rec.finishing THEN "finish" ELSE IF rec.capturing THEN "capture" ELSE "paused"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.closed = disk.named, !.open = 0]
    /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RecordWriteFailure ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "write" /\ reply = "writeError"
    /\ phase' = "discard"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.writeFailed = TRUE, !.capturing = FALSE, !.error = "write"]
    /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

DiscardOpenPiece ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "discard" /\ reply = "none" /\ disk.hidden # 0
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = 0, !.flushed = FALSE]
    /\ reply' = "discarded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RecordDiscard ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "discard" /\ reply = "discarded"
    /\ phase' = IF rec.finishing THEN "finish" ELSE "paused"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.open = 0]
    /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

CaptureEnds ==
    /\ live /\ phase \in {"capture", "write", "name"} /\ rec.capturing
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.capturing = FALSE]
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "capture" THEN "paused" ELSE phase
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

ContinueCapture ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "paused" /\ ~rec.finishing /\ ~rec.writeFailed
    /\ disk.hidden = 0 /\ rec.open = 0
    /\ phase' = "capture" /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.capturing = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

FinishCapture ==
    /\ live /\ phase \in {"capture", "paused", "write", "name", "discard"} /\ ~rec.finishing
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.finishing = TRUE, !.capturing = FALSE]
    /\ phase' = IF phase \in {"capture", "paused"} THEN "finish" ELSE phase
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

IssueJoin ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "finish" /\ rec.closed # {}
    /\ rec.open = 0 /\ disk.hidden = 0 /\ ~disk.joined
    /\ phase' = "join"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.input = Ordered(rec.closed), !.error = "", !.retry = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RecordEmpty ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "finish" /\ rec.closed = {} /\ rec.open = 0 /\ disk.hidden = 0
    /\ phase' = "empty" /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.error = ""]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

\* Clearing an interrupted join's temporary output is a caller substep of
\* the saved join request; it never changes any piece or a named joined file.
DiscardPartialJoin ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "join" /\ reply = "none" /\ disk.partial /\ ~disk.joined
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.partial = FALSE, !.omitted = {}, !.manifest = {}, !.fileOrder = <<>>]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

StartJoin ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "join" /\ reply = "none" /\ ~disk.partial /\ ~disk.joined
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.partial = TRUE]
    /\ reply' = "joining"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

CompleteJoin(omittedPieces) ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "join" /\ reply = "joining" /\ ~disk.joined
    /\ omittedPieces \subseteq rec.closed /\ omittedPieces # rec.closed
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.partial = FALSE, !.joined = TRUE,
                 !.omitted = omittedPieces, !.manifest = omittedPieces,
                 !.fileOrder = Ordered(rec.closed \ omittedPieces)]
    /\ reply' = "joinOK"
    /\ joinPublications' = joinPublications + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered>>

FailJoin ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "join" /\ reply = "joining"
    /\ reply' = "joinError"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

CannotReadAnyPiece ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "join" /\ reply = "joining"
    /\ reply' = "allUnreadable"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RecordJoinFailure ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "join" /\ reply \in {"joinError", "allUnreadable"}
    /\ phase' = "joinFailed"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.error = reply, !.retry = FALSE, !.omissions = {}]
    /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RecordJoinedFile ==
    /\ live /\ phase \in {"join", "publish"} /\ reply = "joinOK" /\ disk.joined
    /\ phase' = "ready"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.omissions = disk.manifest, !.error = "", !.retry = FALSE]
    /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

AskToRetryJoin ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "joinFailed" /\ ~rec.retry
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.retry = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

ScheduleRetry ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.retry
    /\ phase' = "join"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.input = Ordered(rec.closed), !.retry = FALSE, !.error = ""]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RequestHandover ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "ready" /\ disk.joined
    /\ phase' = "deliver"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

\* These callbacks abstract the separate hand-over component's protocol.
\* The sole output identity is this recording's named joined file.
ConfirmHandover ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "deliver"
    /\ phase' = "handed"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.handed = TRUE, !.error = ""]
    /\ delivered' = delivered \cup {JoinedFile}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, recovered, joinPublications>>

FailHandover ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "deliver"
    /\ phase' = "deliveryFailed"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.error = "handover"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RetentionPasses ==
    /\ live /\ rec.handed /\ ~rec.elapsed
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.elapsed = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RequestRemoval ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "handed" /\ EligibleForRemoval
    /\ phase' = "remove"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RemovePieces ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "remove" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.named = {}]
    /\ reply' = "removed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RecordRemoval ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "remove" /\ reply = "removed"
    /\ phase' = "done" /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.closed = {}]
    /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

Crash ==
    /\ live
    /\ live' = FALSE /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, disk, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

Launch ==
    /\ ~live
    /\ LET interrupted == ~disk.joined /\ phase \in {"join", "publish"}
           count == IF interrupted /\ rec.interruptions < MaxInterruptions
                    THEN rec.interruptions + 1 ELSE rec.interruptions
           limitHit == interrupted /\ count = MaxInterruptions
       IN /\ phase' =
                 IF disk.joined THEN
                     IF rec.handed THEN IF disk.named = {} THEN "done" ELSE "handed"
                     ELSE IF phase = "deliveryFailed" THEN "deliveryFailed" ELSE "ready"
                 ELSE IF limitHit THEN "joinFailed"
                 ELSE IF interrupted THEN "join"
                 ELSE IF phase = "joinFailed" THEN "joinFailed"
                 ELSE IF disk.hidden # 0 THEN "discard"
                 ELSE IF rec.finishing THEN "finish" ELSE "paused"
          /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT
                 !.closed = disk.named, !.open = disk.hidden, !.capturing = FALSE,
                 !.omissions = IF disk.joined THEN disk.manifest ELSE {},
                 !.interruptions = count,
                 !.input = IF interrupted THEN Ordered(disk.named) ELSE @,
                 !.retry = ~disk.joined /\ phase = "joinFailed",
                 !.error = IF limitHit THEN "interrupted"
                           ELSE IF interrupted THEN "" ELSE @]
    /\ live' = TRUE /\ reply' = "none" /\ recovered' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, joinPublications>>

WaitForInput ==
    /\ live /\ phase \in {"capture", "paused", "joinFailed", "deliveryFailed", "handed", "empty", "done"}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ BeginPiece \/ WritePiece \/ FailPieceWrite \/ RequestPieceName
    \/ NamePiece \/ RecordPieceName \/ RecordWriteFailure
    \/ DiscardOpenPiece \/ RecordDiscard \/ CaptureEnds \/ ContinueCapture
    \/ FinishCapture \/ IssueJoin \/ RecordEmpty \/ DiscardPartialJoin \/ StartJoin
    \/ (\E omittedPieces \in SUBSET Pieces : CompleteJoin(omittedPieces))
    \/ FailJoin \/ CannotReadAnyPiece \/ RecordJoinFailure \/ RecordJoinedFile
    \/ AskToRetryJoin \/ ScheduleRetry \/ RequestHandover \/ ConfirmHandover

pins.name: JoinedFileIsNamedOnce

model.module_text:
---- MODULE PieceCustody ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, MaxInterruptions, Durations, SpoolPath
VARIABLES phase, rec, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered,
          prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications

vars == <<phase, rec, disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered,
          prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces

JoinedFile == 0

Phases == {"capture", "paused", "write", "name", "discard", "finish",
           "join", "publish", "joinFailed", "ready", "deliver",
           "deliveryFailed", "handed", "remove", "done", "empty"}

Errors == {"", "write", "joinError", "allUnreadable", "interrupted", "handover"}

Replies == {"none", "writeOK", "writeError", "named", "discarded",
            "joining", "joinOK", "joinError", "allUnreadable", "prepared", "removed"}

Ordered(ps) ==
    [i \in 1..Cardinality(ps) |->
        CHOOSE p \in ps : Cardinality({q \in ps : q <= p}) = i]

EligibleForRemoval == rec.handed /\ rec.elapsed

NextPiece == Cardinality(rec.closed) + 1

GapDetails(ps) == {[piece |-> p, seconds |-> lengths[p]] : p \in ps}

Outcome ==
    [status |-> IF phase = "empty" THEN "nothingRecorded"
                ELSE IF rec.handed THEN "handedOver"
                ELSE IF phase = "joinFailed" THEN "joinFailed"
                ELSE IF phase = "deliveryFailed" THEN "handoverFailed"
                ELSE IF rec.writeFailed /\ ~rec.finishing THEN "cannotContinue"
                ELSE "pending",
     error |-> rec.error,
     spool |-> SpoolPath,
     gaps |-> GapDetails(rec.omissions)]

TypeOK ==
    /\ MaxPieces \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ MaxInterruptions \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ Durations \subseteq Nat \ {0}
    /\ Durations # {}
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ rec \in [closed : SUBSET Pieces, open : 0..MaxPieces,
                 finishing : BOOLEAN, capturing : BOOLEAN, writeFailed : BOOLEAN,
                 omissions : SUBSET Pieces,
                 input : UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces},
                 interruptions : 0..MaxInterruptions, error : Errors,
                 handed : BOOLEAN, elapsed : BOOLEAN, retry : BOOLEAN]
    /\ disk \in [named : SUBSET Pieces, hidden : 0..MaxPieces,
                  flushed : BOOLEAN, partial : BOOLEAN, joined : BOOLEAN,
                  omitted : SUBSET Pieces, manifest : SUBSET Pieces,
                  fileOrder : UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}]
    /\ live \in BOOLEAN
    /\ reply \in Replies
    /\ lengths \in [Pieces -> Durations]
    /\ everClosed \subseteq Pieces
    /\ altered \subseteq Pieces
    /\ prematureName \in BOOLEAN
    /\ delivered \subseteq Pieces \cup {JoinedFile}
    /\ recovered \in BOOLEAN
    /\ joinPublications \in 0..2

ClosedPiecesProtected ==
    /\ altered = {}
    /\ ~EligibleForRemoval => disk.named = everClosed

NamesRequireDurableBytes == ~prematureName

NoClosedNumberReuse ==
    (live /\ phase = "write") => rec.open \notin everClosed

WholePiecesAreNamed ==
    /\ disk.named \subseteq everClosed
    /\ phase \notin {"remove", "done"} => rec.closed \subseteq disk.named

ClosedPiecesAreSequential == everClosed = 1..Cardinality(everClosed)

RecoveryAndContinuationUseDisk ==
    (live /\ phase \in {"capture", "paused"}) =>
        /\ rec.closed = disk.named
        /\ NextPiece = Cardinality(disk.named) + 1

CrashPreservesClosedPieces ==
    (~live /\ ~EligibleForRemoval) => everClosed \subseteq disk.named

OpenDebrisIsNotWhole ==
    disk.hidden # 0 => disk.hidden \notin disk.named

JoinHasNoOpenPiece ==
    phase \in {"join", "publish", "ready", "deliver", "deliveryFailed",
               "handed", "remove", "done"} =>
        /\ rec.open = 0
        /\ disk.hidden = 0
        /\ rec.finishing

JoinUsesEveryClosedPieceInOrder ==
    phase \in {"join", "publish", "ready", "deliver", "deliveryFailed",
               "handed", "remove", "done"} =>
        /\ rec.input = Ordered(everClosed)
        /\ Len(rec.input) > 0

JoinedFileContainsTheReadableRemainder ==
    disk.joined =>
        /\ disk.omitted \subseteq everClosed
        /\ disk.omitted # everClosed
        /\ disk.fileOrder = Ordered(everClosed \ disk.omitted)

JoinedFileIsNamedOnce ==
    /\ joinPublications <= 1
    /\ disk.joined = (joinPublications = 1)

GapDetailsSurvive == disk.joined => rec.omissions = disk.omitted

GapsAreReported ==
    (live /\ phase \in {"ready", "deliver", "deliveryFailed", "handed", "remove", "done"}) =>
        /\ rec.omissions = disk.omitted
        /\ Outcome.gaps = GapDetails(disk.omitted)

UnreadablePiecesAreRetained ==
    (disk.joined /\ ~EligibleForRemoval) => disk.omitted \subseteq disk.named

OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver ==
    /\ delivered \subseteq {JoinedFile}
    /\ Cardinality(delivered) <= 1
    /\ delivered # {} => disk.joined

HandedOverMeansConfirmed == rec.handed = (JoinedFile \in delivered)

FailedWorkKeepsRecordingAndError ==
    phase \in {"joinFailed", "deliveryFailed"} =>
        /\ ~rec.handed
        /\ disk.named = everClosed
        /\ Outcome.error # ""
        /\ Outcome.spool = SpoolPath

FailedJoinHandsOverNothing ==
    phase = "joinFailed" => ~disk.joined /\ delivered = {}

FailedWriteStopsCapture == rec.writeFailed => ~rec.capturing

EmptyRecordingHasNoOutput ==
    phase = "empty" =>
        /\ everClosed = {}
        /\ ~disk.joined
        /\ delivered = {}
        /\ Outcome.status = "nothingRecorded"

RemovalRequiresHandoverAndTime == phase \in {"remove", "done"} => EligibleForRemoval

RetryIsScheduled ==
    (live /\ rec.retry) ~> (~live \/ phase = "join")

FinishRequestsJoin ==
    (live /\ phase = "finish" /\ rec.closed # {}) ~> (~live \/ phase = "join")

EmptyFinishReportsNothing ==
    (live /\ phase = "finish" /\ rec.closed = {}) ~> (~live \/ phase = "empty")

HandoverIsRequested ==
    (live /\ phase = "ready") ~> (~live \/ phase = "deliver" \/ rec.handed)

RemovalIsRequested ==
    (live /\ phase = "handed" /\ rec.elapsed) ~> (~live \/ phase = "remove" \/ phase = "done")

NormalHandover == rec.handed /\ rec.omissions = {} /\ everClosed # {}

HandoverWithGap == rec.handed /\ rec.omissions # {}

JoinFailureIsKept == phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.error = "joinError"

UnreadableRecordingIsKept == phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.error = "allUnreadable"

RepeatedInterruptionIsReported == phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.error = "interrupted"

HandoverFailureIsKept == phase = "deliveryFailed"

WriteFailureIsReported == rec.writeFailed /\ ~rec.finishing /\ Outcome.status = "cannotContinue"

NothingRecorded == phase = "empty"

PiecesEventuallyRemoved == phase = "done" /\ everClosed # {} /\ disk.named = {}

NamedPieceBeforeRecord == ~live /\ disk.named \ rec.closed # {}

NamedJoinBeforeRecord == ~live /\ disk.joined /\ phase \in {"join", "publish"}

RecordingCanContinue == recovered /\ phase = "write" /\ rec.open = 2 /\ rec.closed = {1}

RetryCanBePending == live /\ phase = "joinFailed" /\ rec.retry

Init ==
    /\ phase = "capture"
    /\ rec = [closed |-> {}, open |-> 0, finishing |-> FALSE,
               capturing |-> TRUE, writeFailed |-> FALSE, omissions |-> {},
               input |-> <<>>, interruptions |-> 0, error |-> "",
               handed |-> FALSE, elapsed |-> FALSE, retry |-> FALSE]
    /\ disk = [named |-> {}, hidden |-> 0, flushed |-> FALSE,
                partial |-> FALSE, joined |-> FALSE, omitted |-> {},
                manifest |-> {}, fileOrder |-> <<>>]
    /\ live = TRUE
    /\ reply = "none"
    /\ lengths \in [Pieces -> Durations]
    /\ everClosed = {}
    /\ altered = {}
    /\ prematureName = FALSE
    /\ delivered = {}
    /\ recovered = FALSE
    /\ joinPublications = 0

\* rec and phase are the caller's atomically saved record. A change asking
\* for I/O precedes its caller effect. disk models observations, not I/O by
\* this package. lengths are caller-supplied, fixed positive piece durations.
BeginPiece ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "capture" /\ rec.capturing
    /\ ~rec.finishing /\ ~rec.writeFailed
    /\ NextPiece <= MaxPieces /\ disk.hidden = 0 /\ rec.open = 0
    /\ phase' = "write"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT !.open = NextPiece]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, live, reply, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

WritePiece ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "write" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = rec.open, !.flushed = TRUE]
    /\ reply' = "writeOK"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

FailPieceWrite ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "write" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = rec.open, !.flushed = FALSE]
    /\ reply' = "writeError"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, rec, live, lengths, everClosed, altered, prematureName, delivered, recovered, joinPublications>>

RequestPieceName ==
    /\ live /\ phase = "write" /\ reply = "writeOK"
    /\ phase' = "name" /\ reply' = "none"

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The recording starts in Init and follows the modeled bookkeeping and caller steps.

pins.name: ClosedPiecesProtected
pins.says: Every closed piece remains unchanged and present until hand-over is confirmed and the three-day retention period has passed.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every saved value, caller observation and history value has its declared type.

pins.name: NamesRequireDurableBytes
pins.says: A piece receives its name only after the caller has flushed all of its bytes.

pins.name: NoClosedNumberReuse
pins.says: A new piece never takes the number of a piece that has already closed.

pins.name: WholePiecesAreNamed
pins.says: Only named pieces are recorded as whole, except while their authorized removal is being acknowledged.

pins.name: ClosedPiecesAreSequential
pins.says: Closed pieces are numbered consecutively from one.

pins.name: RecoveryAndContinuationUseDisk
pins.says: Before capture starts or resumes, the saved list matches the named pieces on disk and the next number follows the last of them.

pins.name: CrashPreservesClosedPieces
pins.says: A crash cannot lose any closed piece before the recording becomes eligible for removal.

pins.name: OpenDebrisIsNotWhole
pins.says: An unfinished piece under a hidden name is never a named whole piece.

pins.name: JoinHasNoOpenPiece
pins.says: Joining starts only after capture has ended for good and no open piece or hidden piece remains.

pins.name: JoinUsesEveryClosedPieceInOrder
pins.says: Every join request contains every closed piece exactly once in number order and nothing else.

pins.name: JoinedFileContainsTheReadableRemainder
pins.says: A completed joined file contains all readable pieces in order and cannot omit every piece.

pins.name: JoinedFileIsNamedOnce
pins.says: The recording produces at most one named joined file, including across crashes.

pins.name: GapDetailsSurvive
pins.says: Before the joined file receives its name, the saved bookkeeping identifies all omitted pieces and preserves their gap durations.

pins.name: GapsAreReported
pins.says: Once the completed joined file is recognized, the outcome reports each omitted piece and its full duration as a gap.

pins.name: UnreadablePiecesAreRetained
pins.says: Pieces omitted as unreadable remain with the recording until confirmed hand-over and the retention period permit removal.

pins.name: OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver
pins.says: The only file this recording can hand over is its single complete joined file, never a piece.

pins.name: HandedOverMeansConfirmed
pins.says: The recording counts as handed over exactly when the hand-over component confirms its joined file.

pins.name: FailedWorkKeepsRecordingAndError
pins.says: A reported join or hand-over failure keeps every closed piece and exposes the error and spool location in the outcome.

pins.name: FailedJoinHandsOverNothing
pins.says: A reported failed join has no completed output to hand over and has handed over nothing.

pins.name: FailedWriteStopsCapture
pins.says: After a piece-write failure is recorded, that capture cannot accept another piece.

pins.name: EmptyRecordingHasNoOutput
pins.says: A recording with no closed piece reports nothing recorded and produces no joined or handed-over file.

pins.name: RemovalRequiresHandoverAndTime
pins.says: Piece removal can be requested or completed only after confirmed hand-over and the caller reports that three days have passed.

pins.name: NormalHandover
pins.says: A recording with no unreadable piece can be handed over.

pins.name: HandoverWithGap
pins.says: A recording with an unreadable piece can hand over the readable remainder with a reported gap.

pins.name: JoinFailureIsKept
pins.says: A join can fail and leave the recording kept with its error.

pins.name: UnreadableRecordingIsKept
pins.says: A join that cannot read any piece can fail while keeping the recording.

pins.name: RepeatedInterruptionIsReported
pins.says: Repeated interrupted joins can reach the configured limit and report a failure.

pins.name: HandoverFailureIsKept
pins.says: Hand-over can fail while the recording remains kept.

pins.name: WriteFailureIsReported
pins.says: A failed piece write can report that capture cannot continue.

pins.name: NothingRecorded
pins.says: Finishing without a closed piece can report that nothing was recorded.

pins.name: PiecesEventuallyRemoved
pins.says: The pieces of a handed-over recording can be removed after retention expires.

pins.name: NamedPieceBeforeRecord
pins.says: A crash can occur after a piece receives its name but before the saved record includes it.

pins.name: NamedJoinBeforeRecord
pins.says: A crash can occur after the joined file receives its name but before the saved phase records completion.

pins.name: RecordingCanContinue
pins.says: After recovery, capture can continue with piece two following closed piece one.

pins.name: RetryCanBePending
pins.says: A failed join can have a retry pending while the app is running.

pins.name: RetryIsScheduled
pins.says: A pending retry is eventually requested unless another crash interrupts the running app.

pins.name: FinishRequestsJoin

pins.name: EmptyFinishReportsNothing
